Project Overview
ChronoSentiment is institutional replay observability infrastructure — a system for certifying that a given strategy, applied to a market chronology, produces deterministic, auditable, cryptographically-signed results. It is NOT a trading platform, analytics workstation, or general backtesting framework.

## Completed Work
1. Reviewed project structure and architecture
2. Collected all .md files and documentation
3. Read all UI components
4. Cross-referenced docs vs UI implementation
5. Generated discrepancy report
6. Evolved report into constitutional governance document (4 laws + authority hierarchy)
7. Added Section 22: Concept Extraction Pathway
8. Created 5 canonical schemas (event, replay_response, observatory_state, governor_telemetry, decision_trace)
9. Deep-dived entire codebase — audited every UI element against canonical schemas
10. Wrote schemas/canonical/README.md — Law Zero audit surface (every UI element → schema field)
11. Full-stack backend audit (services/api, cs-ingest, observatory) appended to README
12. Implemented first fully schema-conformant replay endpoint (POST /inspect_strategy)
13. Added real SHA-256 signature to certify.rs
14. Reshaped InspectStrategyResponse DTO to emit narrative_blocks[] and trace_signature
15. Added certification_state enum to replay/inspect responses
16. Added source_layer and kernel_signature to EventWrapper/MinimalEvent
17. GA determinism test passed (test_run_ga_api_determinism: 1 passed, 0 failed)
18. Ran full cargo test -p api suite — all 5 tests pass (165s)
19. Created docs/governance/semantic_registry.md — canonical term authority (152 lines)
20. Created docs/governance/event_taxonomy.md — 16 canonical event types (130 lines)
21. Created docs/governance/transitional_artifacts.md — stub/shim registry (148 lines)
22. Created docs/governance/ontology.md — system identity freeze (148 lines)
23. Created docs/governance/runtime_contract.md — infrastructure invariants (partial, cut off mid-Section 4)
24. Searched codebase for EventType/event_type usages (72 results across 15+ files) — confirmed current implementation has 6 SimEvent-level types + 3 MarketEventType subtypes = 9 distinct event concepts
25. Wrote docs/governance/event_taxonomy.md — full 16-type canonical taxonomy with causality rules, certification impact matrix, and implementation gap analysis

## Key Technical Decisions
- `PRICE_SCALE = 10000` — all prices stored as integers, divide by 10000 for ₹
- `BTreeMap` over `HashMap` everywhere for deterministic iteration order
- Deterministic seed derivation (never `from_entropy()`) in GA and centroid calculation; fixed seed `0xDEAD_BEEF_CAFE_1234` for `calculate_alignment_centroid()`
- `execution_fitness` is the single canonical fitness field (not `fitness`, `score`, etc.)
- `ga_fitness` is a separate, non-certified search heuristic
- `certification_state` enum: `CERTIFIED`, `DEGRADED`, `PARTIAL`, `INVALID`
- BLAKE3/SHA-256 for `replay_signature`, `trace_signature`, `kernel_signature`
- `EventType` enum currently has 6 values in `inspector.rs`; canonical taxonomy requires 16
- `MarketEventType` in `core/src/lib.rs` has 3 values: `NewOrder`, `Trade`, `Cancel`
- `EventType::MarketEvent` is NON-CANONICAL — it is a wrapper, not a type; must be decomposed into `MARKET_NEW_ORDER`, `MARKET_TRADE`, or `MARKET_CANCEL`
- Canonical port: `services/api` on 8000, `cs-ingest` on 8001, `observatory` on 8002, UI dev on 3000 (port 8501 is retired)
- `holdout_scenarios` (not `execution_scenarios`) for evaluation isolation semantics
- Hard `assert!` on fitness bounds replaced with `eprintln! + clamp`
- `RawEventType` in `services/api/src/market_adapter.rs` is an internal parsing type — must not leak into canonical event streams

## Relevant Files & Code
- `docs/governance/semantic_registry.md` — canonical field names, forbidden synonyms, enforcement rules (created, 152 lines)
- `docs/governance/event_taxonomy.md` — 16 canonical event types, causality rules, certification impact matrix, implementation gap analysis (created, 130 lines)
- `docs/governance/transitional_artifacts.md` — 8 active artifacts (ARTIFACT-001 through ARTIFACT-008), 6 retired artifacts (created, 148 lines)
- `docs/governance/ontology.md` — system identity, authority hierarchy, forbidden operations by layer, ontological invariants (created, 148 lines)
- `docs/governance/runtime_contract.md` — port assignments, storage policy, environment fingerprint, deterministic execution requirements (created, partial — Section 4 cut off)
- `core/src/types.rs` — EventType enum (6 values, needs expansion to 16)
- `core/src/lib.rs` — `MarketEventType` enum (3 values: NewOrder, Trade, Cancel); `MarketEvent` struct
- `core/src/ga.rs` — GA optimizer (determinism fixes applied)
- `services/api/src/inspector.rs` — `EventType` enum (6 values: OrderIntent, OrderEnteredQueue, QueueProgression, PartialFill, OrderFilled, MarketEvent); `MinimalEvent` struct
- `services/api/src/dto.rs` — DTOs including StrategyEvaluationDto, SystemState (TEMP_DTO), SignalsSnapshotDto (TEMP_DTO); `EventWrapper` with `event_type: String`
- `services/api/src/certify.rs` — real SHA-256 signature implementation
- `services/api/src/signatures.rs` — BLAKE3 kernel_signature for events; input: `sequence_id || timestamp_ns || event_type || source_layer || payload_json`
- `services/api/src/handlers/strategy_handlers.rs` — narrative_blocks[] generation; matches on `event.event_type.as_str()`
- `services/api/src/services/evaluation_service.rs` — maps SimEvent to string event_type
- `services/api/src/market_adapter.rs` — `RawEventType` enum (Trade, Add, Cancel, Unknown); maps to `MarketEventType`
- `services/api/src/replay.rs` — uses `MarketEventType::NewOrder` and `MarketEventType::Trade` directly
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/CompareStrategies.js` — contains ARTIFACT-001 `resolveExecutionFitness()` fallback cascade
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/` — multiple components with fake replay labels (ARTIFACT-006)
- `schemas/canonical/README.md` — Law Zero audit surface

## Current Status
Most recently: Completed `docs/governance/event_taxonomy.md` with full 16-type canonical taxonomy. The taxonomy documents: 9 currently implemented event concepts (6 SimEvent-level + 3 MarketEventType), 7 not-yet-implemented types (ORDER_CANCELLED, POSITION_OPENED, POSITION_CLOSED, EQUITY_SNAPSHOT, REPLAY_SESSION_START, REPLAY_SESSION_END, CERTIFICATION_VERDICT, GOVERNOR_TELEMETRY), and identifies `EventType::MarketEvent` as non-canonical (a wrapper that must be decomposed). Reminders 20 updated to Completed. Reminders 21, 22, 23 still show In Progress (those documents were created in a prior session).

## Pending Tasks
- Complete `docs/governance/runtime_contract.md` (Section 4 was cut off)
- Update reminders 21–23 from "In Progress" to "Completed" (those docs were already created)
- Real SHA-256 replay signatures — enable actual certification authority
- Canonical replay DTO emission — allow observer UI reconstruction
- Backend narrative_blocks[] — eliminate largest LAW THREE cluster
- certification_state propagation — make replay validity explicit
- Removal of frontend fallback resolution (ARTIFACT-001: `resolveExecutionFitness()`)
- Event taxonomy expansion (16 event types in `core/src/types.rs` / `inspector.rs`)
- Verify/remove phantom types `UnifiedStrategyEvaluation` / `UnifiedGaResponse` (ARTIFACT-007)
- Standardize port references (ARTIFACT-008)
- New artifacts to register: ARTIFACT-009 through ARTIFACT-016 (the 7 unimplemented event types + `EventType::MarketEvent` non-canonical wrapper)
